multi_root_algebraic_expression.verification: Bind an immutable checked Cartesian-system RUR to exact original coefficient equations and typed variables. Independently check every coordinate against the requested input root's uniquely isolating interval. Structurally substitute the held original source and independently recheck the final value and every source-domain guard.
multi_root_algebraic_expression.public: Genuine built-in CRootOf objects lower to distinct typed Dummy bindings. Keep one-root fast path; compose several roots for N/evalf, algebraic sign facts and relations. Immutable Python AlgebraicExpressionValue exposes accepted bounds/decimal/precision/binding count.
multi_root_algebraic_expression.limits: Real embeddings only; bounded rational Add/Mul/integer-Pow grammar. No general minimal polynomials, transcendental functions, arbitrary composita or portable RUR proof certificate.

rational_graph_families.verification: Each normalized pivot relation is independently bound by a nonzero exact scale to an original equation or checked basis element. Bound unit-ideal witnesses prove every denominator nonzero on the entire original variety; exact cleared-denominator residuals verify every original equation for every allowed free tuple. Missing exceptional fibers cannot be silently discarded.
rational_graph_families.public: nonlinsolve attempts this path only after the finite solver's explicit InfiniteSolutions outcome, under the same budgets. rational_family returns separately checked numerator, denominator and nonzero-condition expressions. Python verifies guard correspondence and constructs held inverse operations so lifting cannot cancel parameter exclusions.
rational_graph_families.limits: One recognized complete graph; no unions of rational charts, general exceptional-fiber stratification, or original source equations containing reciprocals. Existing finite solver and polynomial-component behavior retained.

selected_component_rational_recognition.verification: Only finite-decimal rational candidates from agreed endpoint rounding are proposed. Exact original numerator-minus-value-times-denominator membership and the independent checker must accept before singleton publication.
selected_component_rational_recognition.regression: Opposite sqrt(2) embeddings give exact (x-y)^2=8. x^2 at selected roots of (x^2-2)(x^2-3) gives exact 2 or 3. sqrt(4+2^-200) remains a non-singleton interval even when its decimal rounds to 2; forged exact-2 certificate is rejected.
selected_component_rational_recognition.limits: Does not implement general rational reconstruction or recognition of every nonterminating rational image.
